dct_title_s: King County, Washington : Wastewater Treatment Division (WTD) facility footprints
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington Wastewater Treatment Division (WTD) building footprints of treatment plants or other facilities.
Purpose: To identify the building footprints for WTD facilities for use in a GIS.

Supplemental information: Plans for the West Point and Renton Treatment plants were obtained from Engineering Services as CAD drawings. Other facilities were digitized from source maps received from Engineering Services. Only those facilities with adequate registration marks were automated. Facilities placed with reference to coordinate information on plans obtained from Engineering Services and may not correspond to sewer network.
